description: This file defines a GatewayHealthMonitor class that performs periodic health checks for a gateway, managing failures and timeouts. It includes configuration settings, start/stop control, and uses asynchronous tasks and timeout mechanisms.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class that manages periodic health checks for a gateway, including failure handling and timeout management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer to set up configuration and sleep function.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health monitoring task, executing the check periodically.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health check task.

methods.name: runCheck
methods.description: Performs a single health check with optional timeout handling.
